provenance.line: gelf_to_json, and the assertions in test_valid_gelf_message
provenance.note: GELF is already JSON, so the converter keeps the sender's object and adds three things: message copied from short_message, severity mapped off the numeric level, and _source. Underscore-prefixed keys such as _user_id are GELF's own additional-field convention and pass through untouched.
